source.evidence: Source atomic coordinates: camilla.data SHA256 69e8be921c019d3a860cbf05067aab95129832255816b00fe27282c99de3ba9e. Type identities Si/O/H are inferred from coordination and distances; source provides no element names, bond topology or molecule labels. Selection retains every Si and O within 2.0 Å of any Si using the periodic cell, and removes all H and other O. The H-free selected coordinates SHA256 is 5145761db4e8b85c4e8ad76757913dd47a3448c73c3abc7b2e9c7bfce3e48a97. Reviewed76mm native3MF SHA256 b7ca8341574c964721b5fd1565940e48c529b71a0c143234a18c381d66b481e3; exact sourceSTL SHA2565220d5d221c47a45ae7b1da6628c6bd9683551e58454e728664749af88c1913f. EmbeddedG-code MD5 and fullZIPCRC passed; actualPLA/PVAroles, depositedarc-and-linewidthbounds and source-to-Gcode transforms reviewed.

notes: The76mm candidate completed native slicing and artifact review:58.79gPLA,182.01gPVA and43h39m25s estimated print time (380 layers at0.20mm). This fits the196g PVA planning allowance derived from the last245g remaining estimate with20% reserve; about62.99g would remain by estimate. Fresh filament availability still needs checking. The exact3MF passed full archiveCRC, embeddedG-code checksum, material-role and deposited-bounds checks. Root and independent reviews inspected native previews, sampled full-plate deposition, four weak-contact regions and two pore regions. All four contacts retain modeled bead coverage, with an explicit PLA crossing at one; sampling and bead proxies do not establish physical joining or strength. All72,500 selected main-component atoms, the full core and original Si/O radius ratio are retained;882 boundary-fragment exclusions remain recorded. Automatic start is held pending printer relocation and fresh connection/nozzle/material/fault/bed-camera checks, exact-file upload/readback and one durable start intent. No upload/start or physical result has occurred. The43h39m estimate misses theOctober26 end-of-work target; PVA removal and drying time are additional and unverified. The native preview/top images show the model; separate actual-path images show internal PVA and the prime tower.
